scripts.codegen: pnpm run dependency:check && orval --config ./orval.config.ts && CODEGEN_ENSURE_SKIP=1 pnpm -w run typecheck:libs
scripts.codegen:check: pnpm run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- ../../lib/api-client-react/src/generated ../../lib/api-zod/src/generated && pnpm run spec:check && pnpm run barrel:check && pnpm run dist:check
scripts.codegen:fix: pnpm run codegen && if git status --porcelain -- ../../lib/api-client-react/src/generated ../../lib/api-zod/src/generated | grep -q .; then git add ../../lib/api-client-react/src/generated ../../lib/api-zod/src/generated && git commit -m 'chore: regenerate api clients [post-merge]'; fi && pnpm run spec:check
